name: dsh-cli-mcp
description: MCP server that delegates coding tasks to your locally installed DeepSeek Harness CLI (dsh).

scripts.check: npm run check:format && npm run check:types
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.build:tests: tsc --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target ES2023 --lib ES2023 --types node --esModuleInterop true --skipLibCheck true --outDir dist-test test/fake-dsh.ts test/fake-dsh-cli.ts && (echo "#!/usr/bin/env node" | cat - dist-test/fake-dsh-cli.js > /tmp/_f && mv /tmp/_f dist-test/fake-dsh-cli.js) && chmod +x dist-test/fake-dsh-cli.js

author: Karataev Pavel (https://github.com/minmax)
